stdout: package: @astryxdesign/lab # DialogHeroHeader High-emphasis sibling of DialogHeader for featured/marketing/onboarding dialogs. Drops into Layout header slot; media bleeds to dialog edges; title names the dialog; visible title is the default initial focus target. Import from @astryxdesign/lab and load core + lab CSS; install both packages at @canary. **Import:** `import {DialogHeroHeader} from '@astryxdesign/lab';` ## Best Practices - **Do:** Match mediaMode to the media luminance for close-button contrast. - **Do:** Size media to fill the slot (width 100%). - **Do:** Keep CTAs in LayoutFooter. - **Do:** Use isTitleHidden when the media carries the message; SR name is kept. - **Don't:** Use for routine confirmations/forms; use DialogHeader. ## Props | Prop | Type | Default | Description | |------|------|---------|-------------| | `title` | `string \| ReactElement` | - | Dialog title. A string is wrapped in a level 2 Heading (matching DialogHeader); pass a pre-styled Heading element to customize the treatment. Provides the accessible label for the parent Dialog via aria-labelledby unless the Dialog has an explicit label. The visible title is the default initial focus target; another eligible descendant autofocus request takes priority. A custom Heading receives the label and focus on its own element; if it sets its own id, name the Dialog with aria-labelledby. **(required)** | | `media` | `ReactNode` | - | Full-bleed visual rendered above the title (image, illustration, or icon). Stretches to the dialog's padded edges; the close button overlays its top-trailing corner. Size the media itself (e.g. width 100%) to fill the slot. **(required)** | | `mediaMode` | `'light' \| 'dark'` | - | Luminance of the media surface. Composes MediaTheme under the hood so content overlaid on the media (the close button) picks up contrast-safe inverted tokens: 'dark' media gets light overlay content, 'light' media gets dark. Omit to keep ambient theme tokens. | | `isTitleHidden` | `boolean` | `false` | Visually hides the title row while keeping it available to screen readers, so the dialog stays named by the title. | | `startContent` | `ReactNode` | - | Content placed before the title (e.g. an icon), inline with the heading. | | `maxLines` | `number` | - | Max lines before the title truncates with an ellipsis. Only applies when title is a string (auto-wrapped in a Heading). | | `onOpenChange` | `(isOpen: boolean) => unknown` | - | Close button callback, called with false when the close button is clicked. If not provided, no close button is rendered. Same contract as DialogHeader. | | `hasDivider` | `boolean` | - | Adds a themed border at the bottom edge. Defaults to the parent Layout's defaultHasDividers context value. | ## Examples ### Onboarding dialog ```tsx import {DialogHeroHeader} from '@astryxdesign/lab'; import '@astryxdesign/core/astryx.css'; import '@astryxdesign/lab/lab.css'; const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(true); } mediaMode="dark" onOpenChange={setIsOpen} /> } content={Get started in three steps.} footer={ ``` ### Hidden title (media carries the message) ```tsx } isTitleHidden onOpenChange={setIsOpen} /> ```
